title: Color Picker (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Color Picker applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Color Picker (BtnPickColor) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnPickColor deterministic Office leg (text-target apply without the RTF probe)

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the color picker's apply path (ApplyColorToSelection, the exact code the eyedropper calls after sampling) runs on the fixture 3x3 table with a 40x20 text probe selected: the probe's text font color becomes OLE red 255 while its text content and geometry stay unchanged and the table remains untouched (3x3, 100/50 cells, 300x150 at 40/40, texts intact); the run writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry - the former impossible dynamic .Rtf probe on TextRange logged one error per text-target apply - reports execution, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the color picker's apply path (ApplyColorToSelection, the exact code the eyedropper calls after sampling) runs on the fixture 3x3 table with a 40x20 text probe selected: the probe's text font color becomes OLE red 255 while its text content and geometry stay unchanged and the table remains untouched (3x3, 100/50 cells, 300x150 at 40/40, texts intact); the run writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry - the former impossible dynamic .Rtf probe on TextRange logged one error per text-target apply - reports execution, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
